card.name: Spots where "enable" could come next
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation right where the next word could plausibly be a form of "enable" (by, to, at, a dash). Also fires after "disabled CSS" and before "enabled"-type phrasing.

modes.label: Linking words before enable

modes.label: Punctuation after disabled
modes.description: A period or pronoun right after a phrase about something being disabled or turned off.

modes.label: Phrase before a goal clause
modes.description: A word like to or a dash where a phrase about allowing or enabling an outcome could follow.
